Economics BSc at University of Birmingham

What University of Birmingham asks of applicants to Economics BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Birmingham courses · Economics & Finance field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 8 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma: SAT/ACT is not required — the route is a High School Diploma with a minimum 3.2/4.0 unweighted GPA plus three subject tests (AP tests, IB HL subjects, honours or college-level classes)
  • An ACT composite of 28+ or SAT-R of 1350+ (no superscores) may replace one of the three subject tests, but not a required subject
Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: USA – entry requirements
English language
  • IELTS (Academic): 6.5 overall with 6.5 in Writing and Speaking and 6.0 in Listening and Reading
  • TOEFL: 88 overall with no less than 21 in Reading, 20 in Listening, 22 in Speaking and Writing
  • Pearson PTE: 67 overall, with 67 in Writing and Speaking and no less than 64 in Reading and Listening
  • Cambridge C1 Advanced: 176 overall, 176 in Writing and Speaking, no less than 169 in Reading and Listening
Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Economics BSc

Verified19 Oct 2026Birmingham: Economics BSc · Birmingham: Undergraduate entry requirements
Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement (for applicants with a US high-school diploma, GPA 3.2+): three subject tests, which may be AP tests — AAA equates to three AP tests at grade 5 on Birmingham’s equivalence table (AP 5 = A* or A; AP 4 = B)
  • The A-level Mathematics requirement must be met with AP Calculus BC (AP Calculus AB is not accepted) or IB HL Mathematics
  • AP tests must be the certified test; AP classes alone are not accepted
